input: No arguments or --json; collect current workstation, never the DB server on behalf of a client.
output: Versioned IdentitySnapshot JSON: workstation_name, user_name, hardware_serial and explicit read issues. Missing values are null. No filesystem paths or project state.
serial_policy: Prefer device serial; use genuine processor serial only if device serial is unavailable. Never substitute ProcessorId, UUID, MAC address, disk serial or generated data.
identity_policy: Provenance metadata, not authentication or a globally unique project/session identifier. Local OS account name is not an authenticated network user ID.
